mechanics.claim: Aurora is locked out of using all abilities, summoner spells, and item actives during the dash, and cannot buffer casts to fire after the lockout.
mechanics.quote: '''Aurora''' is locked out of using all abilities, summoner spells, and item actives during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Using a basic attack breaks the invisibility stealth at the end of the attack windup.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: If Aurora's dash is interrupted, she does not gain the invisibility.
mechanics.quote: '''Aurora''' will '''not''' gain the stealth if her dash is interrupted.

mechanics.claim: Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them resets the ability's cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reset ''Across the Veil's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.

mechanics.claim: Realm Hopper's re-application does not stack; it overrides the previous buff's duration only if the new total duration is longer than the remaining one.
mechanics.quote: If the '''total''' duration of ''Realm Hopper'' gained from a new cast of ''Across the Veil'' or ''{{ai|Between Worlds|Aurora}}'' is longer than the '''remaining''' duration of the one gained from a previous cast, then re-gaining ''Realm Hopper'' will override the previous buff's duration.
